name: Sonic Vitality
long_description: Sonic Vitality is a currently indefinitely delayed fangame, worked on at an irregular pace since August 2019 and totalling an estimated 3,000+ hours of actual work. It was originally planned as a Generations-length Sonic adventure for both PC and PS Vita
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
